action_params.code_js: (() => { const value = Array.from(el(36).querySelectorAll('*')).find(e => /^\d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}$/.test(e.textContent.trim()))?.textContent.trim(); if (!value) return null; const [h,m,s] = value.split(':').map(Number); const minutes = Math.ceil((h * 3600 + m * 60 + s) / 60); return `${String(Math.floor(minutes / 60)).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(minutes % 60).padStart(2,'0')}`; })()
